summary: The note briefly describes the Ninth Amendment (Amendment IX) to the United States Constitution. It states that the amendment addresses rights retained by the people that are not specifically enumerated in the Constitution, and that it is part of the Bill of Rights.
one_line: The Ninth Amendment (Amendment IX) to the U.S. Constitution covers rights retained by the people that are not specifically enumerated in the document.
key_facts: The Ninth Amendment is also known as Amendment IX to the United States Constitution.
The Ninth Amendment addresses rights retained by the people that are not specifically enumerated in the Constitution.
The Ninth Amendment is part of the Bill of Rights.

entities.name: Ninth Amendment to the United States Constitution
entities.role: Amendment (Amendment IX) addressing unenumerated rights retained by the people, part of the Bill of Rights
